newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH FIGHTER JET CRASHES, CREW'S FATE UNKNOWN.
newsitem.headline: CZECH FIGHTER JET CRASHES, CREW'S FATE UNKNOWN.

text.p: A Czech army MiG-23 fighter aircraft crashed while training in the southeastern part of the country on Tuesday, the local news agency CTK reported.
It said that it was not yet known what happened to the crew, and a cause for the crash has not been given.
The aircraft can have a crew of one or two.
Czech military officials were not immediately available for further comment.
The jet crashed on Tuesday afternoon between the villages of Heralec and Darko, about 120 km (75 miles) southeast of the capital Prague, CTK said, but there were no reports of injuries on the ground.
The crash was the Czech army's second jet to go down in three weeks.
A Soviet-made Su-22 M4 fighter/bomber crashed and killed the pilot on a training run on November 1.
